title: [spec-gap][R-X509-002/003/004/005] CA proof of possession: PKCS#10 certificationRequestInfo self-signature verification
description: spec/appendix-x509-cert-profile.md preamble: before issuing, the CA MUST verify the requester controls the subject private key; for a PKCS#10 request the CA MUST verify the self-signature over the DER-encoded certificationRequestInfo using the carried subject public key (RFC 2986) and MUST reject a request whose signature does not verify; MUST NOT issue without PoP; no custom CSR format. Classification: not-implemented (no CA issuance tooling in repo; .lichen.tech CA is design-only docs/ca-lichen-tech-design.md). Suggested placement: python CA/provisioning tool using cryptography.x509.CertificateSigningRequest signature verification, under scripts/ or python/src/lichen/ca; oracle = pyca/cryptography per repo test discipline.
